description.en: Sets up and plays a tactic ("tac") cutscene given a tactic ID and the attacking/defending team rosters, on a given map.
ID of the tactic to play.
ID of the map to play the tactic on.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Set up and play a tactic cutscene
CMND_SETUP_RUN_TAC(_tacID, _aAtk, _aDef, 0, _mapID);
